description: Use for "where am I losing buyers?" or "people click but don't buy". Returns each step from ad click to purchase as how many in 1,000 move on, the e-commerce benchmark per 1,000, above or below, the trend, and which step loses the most buyers. For totals like spend and ROAS use get_performance; for why visitors leave the store use get_store_checks. Saved data, refreshed by the hourly check.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
